newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products all soften, fuel only slightly.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all soften, fuel only slightly.

text.p: NWE oil products were all softer on Wednesday, although fuel oil was only marginally off, dealers said.
Gasoline was $1 lower for physical product and about $2 on the swaps. One eurograde barge traded at $200.50 fob Rotterdam.
Traders said the lower swaps, and therefore narrower contango to June, had discouraged buying interest for prompt product.
"The buyers have backed away. Prompt is not quiet so cheap, but of course it may come off more," one trader said.
A regular barge traded at $192.75 fob Rotterdam.

Heating oil barges were off by most, down $3 as prompt IPE futures dropped. The physical market, however, was barely changed and offers remained at IPE June +$2 fob Rotterdam. Bids were at least $1 below.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were slightly weaker as bids came off $1 to $83 fob Rotterdam, although offers held at $85 fob. One barge traded at $84.
Bunker demand showed some signs of improvement through the morning, as enquiries rose above 10,000 tonnes.
